Class GTri

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitter
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitterAndListener
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GObject
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.geometry.GTri
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface, EventListener, IdempotentEventListener<GPointMovedEvent, Vector3>, CanCopy, DecomposeWhenDrawn<Triangle>, SceneObject, HasProperties
public final class GTri extends GObject implements IdempotentEventListener<GPointMovedEvent, Vector3>, DecomposeWhenDrawn<Triangle>
GTri represents a Triangle. What'd you expect kau.

A GTri's pivot is set to it's geometric centre between the 3 points.

Unlike the other GObjects, a GTri is a bit more complicated in that it can be defined in terms of its points or its lines. It is also where most of the "complex" engine stuff are done like depth calculations or normal calculations.

A GTri, is stored by reference like any other GObject within a Thing. it is also stored within SceneRenderer for draw ordering.

Lehlogonolo Poole
